fields.line1run1: I’ve noticed some articles in Over the Edge seem like they
fields.line2run1: could be AI-generated. Can you clarify your stance on AI
fields.line3run1: usage and explain how you ensure the content is original

fields.line1run1: Thanks for asking about AI in Over the Edge! Yes, we do use AI tools, and we want to be upfront about that.
fields.line2run1: While our students are the creative force behind every story, we use AI to help with things like smoothing
fields.line3run1: out paragraph transitions, grammar checks, and making our writing flow more naturally. Right now, we’re
fields.line4run1: experimenting with these tools to figure out what works best - it’s very much a learning process for all of us.
fields.line5run1: Everything you read still comes from our student journalists’ minds and experiences, with AI just helping to
fields.line6run1: polish the final product. We’re learning and improving as we go, and we really appreciate feedback from our
fields.line7run1: readers as we work to find the right balance. Student journalism is still at the heart of everything we do!
